# x402-base58-toolkit

Deterministic Base58 / Base58Check encode & decode microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/base58 — paid

## Pricing
~0.003–0.008 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "action": "encode"|"decode"|"encodeCheck"|"decodeCheck", "data": "...", "version?": number }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
